correctness.rationale: The published run-length-transform identity for this exact binomial-parity sum is independently located at Rampersad--Wiebe Theorem 13. The companion recurrence is positive and invertible modulo every power of two. Exact modular state returns establish the 5- and 10-period residue patterns, hence the two rational run-weight series. Formal binary-word factorization gives the renewal function, whose coefficient extraction yields the displayed zero- and one-valuation rational enumerators and an algorithm for every fixed valuation. A unique simple smallest-modulus zero of the pentanacci denominator gives an order-v+1 pole with positive nonzero leading coefficient, hence the explicit asymptotic constant for every fixed v. Standalone direct calculations corroborate 2000 original binomial sums and 262143 binary-word histogram entries; these finite tests are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The object is a natural 2023 binomial count of odd products, whose exact 2-adic divisibility had not been classified in inspected material. The theorem distinguishes the first extra factor of two with a new explicit rational count and identifies a full ladder of fixed-valuation frequencies, each with a strictly increasing polynomial power on top of a common pentanacci exponential base. This is an infinite-family arithmetic distribution law, not an isolated numerical sample, arbitrary slice, or mere restatement of the known zero-valuation sequence.
